shows: An unmodified, seeded frame of normal play on wave 6 in the Lantern Observatory. The Prism split sends Ember, Verdant and Azure beams bouncing off brass mirrors, each harming a creature of its own colour, while two beams glance off creatures of another colour and the game tags them '× WRONG COLOUR', so the still frame teaches the rule. 14 creatures are in view (hooded imps, Bulwarks with three-colour shells, a Prismling, a soot-moth). Combo x6, Core 12/12, and the cream-and-brass HUD (WIN/LOSE line, '0 = RUN LOST', wave goal, INCOMING, event log, MATCH COLOUR, build cards, key caps). Chosen by tools/find-cover.mjs (teach mode) from 1,200 autopilot runs.
